scope: The grader compares source-only complete traces for the four bounded #4102 cases. It never establishes runtime behavior, production truth, general completeness, or #4103/#4104 architecture.

validation: candidate case ids exactly match the four reference cases with no duplicates
each candidate raw_record_inventory exactly matches its reference case
each candidate rejected_relations and rejected_annotations exactly match the frozen reference
relation, unknown, and contradiction ids are unique within each case
every accepted relation, unknown, and contradiction has at least one complete revision-bound source span
each relation unknown_ids and contradiction_ids value is a list of existing case-local annotation ids
extra relations score false and duplicate identifiers reject the candidate

deterministic_grader.boundary: The grader receives a frozen canonical reference and a frozen candidate only after blind extraction. It does not use raw-lane records, adjudications, historical receipts, or a control identifier as an independent verification oracle.

source_replay.method: For every quoted source span, resolve repository_path at the candidate case source_revision with git show; compare source SHA-256 and exact UTF-8 byte slice before scoring.
rejection_conditions: candidate source revision differs from the canonical case revision
a relation or annotation has no complete replayable source span

acceptance_threshold.receipt_requirement: A separately authored independent complete-trace receipt must identify the frozen reference, candidate, source-replay result, and complete record-integrity digest before any accepted or independently-verified claim.

historical_receipts.wording: The retained immutable historical receipts cover six declared claim projections. They do not grade or independently verify the complete trace reference.
